what: for each of 80 national teams (anonymous, unordered), the distance from its own goal line, in metres on a 105 m pitch, within which 90% of its pressures on the ball carrier were made: how far up the pitch it goes to press
source: computed from StatsBomb open data (men's World Cup 2022, Euro 2020, Euro 2024; 166 matches with 360 data), Pressure events. Data: StatsBomb.
